notes: Reconciled on 2026-10-09 against the journal PDF. Read all 522 markdown lines, including references, back matter and the appended Reporting Summary, and extracted the text of all twelve PDF pages with pymupdf. Recovered and checked Table 1 with find_tables(). The six study records follow the printed experiment labels. Independently checked the agreed participant counts, question, construct, unit, higher_is, AI availability and within-person status against Methods and Results. All retained outcomes are immediate with_ai outcomes from between-participant random assignment; there are no across_people or after_ai estimates in this paper. Creativity, originality, appropriateness, idea count and articulateness are distinguished; articulateness is other and higher means clearer presentation. Participant-level averaging is stated for Experiment 1; the remaining human tasks require one idea per person. The Experiment 2B mixed human/model analysis retains an output unit and participant-based uncertainty because each randomized person contributes one idea; the three-group error-term caveat remains. The qualitative top-ranked share remains an output record with no inferential denominator. Judge counts and model responses are never used as participant counts. No statistics are calculated from means, degrees of freedom, p-values, graphs, or other quantities. Confidence bounds for Cohen d occupy paper_effect and the general CI fields with ci_of=paper_effect; they are not raw-difference intervals. Every numeric field is mapped to exactly one source entry; source quotes preserve printed precision and signs, normalizing whitespace. Table quotes copy the row label and selected cells returned by find_tables(). Empty clusters_per_arm objects denote individual randomization, not missing cluster counts. Model-only arms are documented in not_extracted, not listed as randomized human arms. Factorial cell comparisons cover complete randomized arms; interaction, non-AI-factor, and participant subgroup analyses are excluded. All screening-form outcomes and contrasts have an estimate or an explicit not_extracted entry. No further eligible contrast missing from both extractors could be confirmed. The shared-sample link to c015 is carried from the screening form and codebook; no c015 statistics are imported. Requests via urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1 to the named OSF project API and then the publisher failed with socket-access denial; no external supplement was used. The repeated n_total difference in the comparison script is resolved once. Supplement update: the preceding main-PDF reconciliation narrative is retained as historical provenance; statements there that supplements were unavailable or statistics were absent are superseded by this update and the current estimates/open_items. Both supplied supplementary PDFs and their markdown conversions were read in full. The supplementary tables were recovered with pymupdf.find_tables(), and the inconsistent expert table was also visually checked in memory. All original numeric fields are preserved. Added values are transcribed, including negative effect signs and internally inconsistent test statistics; no missing statistic is computed. New novelty-category uncertainty is rating-based because the random effect is for judges, not participants. Top-ranked shares remain in printed percent units with output-based uncertainty. Preregistered data collection does not identify a preregistered primary test, so preregistered_primary remains not_stated. Supplement verification correction: all full-sample Experiment 2B human-arm contrasts record n_total = 200 from the main Methods (PDF p. 7, printed p. 1912). The supplement prints 300 complete responses for the mixed human/model analysis; per-arm human counts and category-rating counts remain unreported. supplement_changes records edits to pre-existing fields and appended provenance/exclusion/open-item entries; supplement_added lists new estimate slugs, whose numerical sources are recorded within those estimates. Existing resolutions, fixes and kept audit records are unchanged. Change-log indexes for existing exclusion/open-item entries refer to their pre-update positions. Supplement-fix pass: both supplied check reports were checked against the main PDF and supplements after reading all three markdown conversions in full, including appendices and references.
